headline: Wetlands review of school turf fields and playground at 2 New Bond Street, and a dock at 413 Lake Avenue.
summary: Two wetland jurisdiction requests, a school's turf field and playground project at 2 New Bond Street, and a deck and dock replacement at 413 Lake Avenue are listed. Other items include certificate requests, project changes at Southwest Cutoff and Barber Avenue, and 19 enforcement and violation updates.
items: Mill Street right-of-way: whether utility pole replacement needs wetlands review (CC-2026-071)
321 Greenwood Street: whether the lot needs wetlands review (CC-2026-072)
2 New Bond Street (Abby Kelley Foster Charter Public School): replace two synthetic turf fields, a playground, and fencing (CC-2026-068)
413 Lake Avenue: replace deck and dock, install new footings (CC-2026-070)
Certificate of compliance requests for 80 Barber Avenue and Curtis Apartments Phase 1
Project change requests for 315 & 317 Southwest Cutoff and 301 Barber Avenue
Discussion of enforcement orders and violations at 19 properties
Informal discussion of proposed work at 215 Lake Avenue
Communications: Lake Quinsigamond vegetation plan review and Salisbury Pond aquatic management report
Update to Wetlands Protection Ordinance and Regulations
location: Levi Lincoln Chamber, 3rd Floor (Room 309), 455 Main Street, Worcester City Hall
